description: The Turbine Blade is a tiny, elongated component situated at the middle-center-rear of the jet engine, crafted from Blades texture 1 material. It is responsible for extracting energy from the hot gases produced by combustion, converting it into mechanical energy to drive the engine. Notably, the Turbine Blade's elongated shape enables it to efficiently harness the kinetic energy of the gases.

The Rear Blade is a tiny, elongated component situated at the middle-center-rear of the engine, crafted from Blades texture material. As part of the engine's turbine section, it helps to extract energy from the exhaust gases, converting it into mechanical energy. Notably, its unique shape and material properties enable it to withstand the high-temperature and high-stress environment of the turbine.

The Rear Blade Shroud is a thin, flat component positioned at the middle-center-rear of the engine. It serves as a protective casing for the Rear Blade, shielding it from the surrounding environment and facilitating smooth airflow. Interestingly, its thin design allows for minimal obstruction of the airflow, maximizing the engine's overall efficiency.
